name: Cinderwisp
ability: When Cinderwisp enters play, give another Ember spirit +1 ATK until end of turn.
flavor: “Follow the small light,” the old guides said. Few asked where it led.

name: Tidecaller Maru
ability: Return target spirit with SPD 2 or less to its owner’s hand.
flavor: The harbor bells ring twice before she rises.

name: Mossback Elder
ability: Mossback Elder can’t be moved by effects your opponents control.
flavor: It has been asleep since the forest was a single seed.

name: Galvanir
ability: Deal 2 damage to each enemy spirit. If one is destroyed this way, repeat once.
flavor: Count the seconds between the flash and the roar. Then stop counting.

name: Nyxshade
ability: Nyxshade can’t be targeted while you control another Void spirit.
flavor: Where the lantern fails, she is already waiting.

name: Archsovereign Pyrrhaxion, the Unquenchable Ember of the Ninth Caldera
ability: At the start of each turn, deal 1 damage to every other spirit. Pyrrhaxion heals 1 for each spirit damaged.
flavor: Nine calderas. Nine kings. One fire that never learned to die.

name: Ætherwyrm Ölsén
ability: Push each enemy spirit with DEF 3 or less to the back row.
flavor: “Skål to the wind,” øne sailor laughed — and the wind answered.

name: Lantern Moth
ability: When Lantern Moth is destroyed, draw a card.
flavor: They gather at dusk in the hollows of the old wood, a thousand small lamps that drift and dim and brighten again, and the villagers say each one is a promise somebody forgot to keep, still circling the place where it was made, still waiting to be remembered, still burning, patiently, against the coming dark of a winter that has not yet arrived.

name: 光の狐 Hikari-no-Kitsune ✨
ability: Create two 1/1 Mirage tokens. They copy Hikari’s ability text.
flavor: 「光を追う者は、影に迷う」 — old proverb

name: Grimward Sentinel
ability: Enemy spirits can’t attack you unless their controller pays 2 for each. Whenever an enemy spirit attacks another player, Grimward Sentinel gets +1 DEF permanently and you may return a destroyed Void spirit from your discard pile to your hand. This ability can’t be copied, negated or moved.
flavor: It has never once opened the gate.

name: Seraphel, Dawn’s Last Light
ability: When Seraphel enters play, restore every friendly spirit to full DEF and give them +2 SPD.
flavor: The sky remembers her color long after she has gone.

name: Riftling
ability: Riftling can swap places with an adjacent friendly spirit once per turn.
